## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich lasse mich davon inspirieren.** — [ish LAH-suh mish dah-FON in-shpee-REER-en] — *I'm letting myself be inspired by it.*
2. **Das klingt nach einem guten Plan.** — [das klingt nahkh EYE-nem GOO-ten plahn] — *That sounds like a good plan.*
3. **Ich genieße den Moment.** — [ish guh-NEE-suh dayn mo-MENT] — *I'm enjoying the moment.*
